tags._note_height_cm: 11-05h: every robot's FIRST GUESS (Jay-Sun's platform is the same on every robot: 2 7/16 in), so a robot not named in heights_cm (AL-1DC0 got Alpha's by name; a third robot got the 6.0 placeholder) starts from it. Measure fits each roof tag's height by its tag id where two cameras see it (roof_cal); the binding carries it to whichever robot wears that tag.

tags._note_binding: 5 Nov 2026 (Nick): wiggle-first naming before every run with roof tags (wiggle_bind.py; mission_run, Mission Control runs, experiments, the calibration run). binding: wiggle (default) or fixed (ids above, the old way, kept). slot_by: position (each robot gets the slot whose home is nearest where the camera sees it; a robot listed in robots[] with "wifi": "AL-xxxx" is pinned to that slot) or name (a robot already called Alpha keeps Alpha). rename_to_slot: the robot is renamed with `name <slot>` (kept on the robot) so the run knows it by its slot.
tags._note_pins_2026_11_05: Jay-Sun 5 Nov: Alvik 3 = AL-1DC0 tag 2, Alvik 4 = AL-EB54 tag 3, Alvik 5 = AL-E7DC tag 4; Alpha (Alvik 1, tag 0) and Bravo (Alvik 2, tag 1) flashed Monday and carry RFID; tag 5 spare. Typed pins are a first guess only: every run's check wiggle confirms the tag that really turns (observe, then trust).
tags._note_pins: 5 Nov 2026 11:00 (Nick): rename_to_slot false at school: robots keep their own names (AL-xxxx); the slot (Alpha / Bravo) lives in the run only (run_plan --alias). Set true to rename on the robot as before (kept). pin true: once a wiggle has found which roof tag is on which robot (by its WiFi name AL-xxxx), the Pi keeps it in its site folder (robot_pins.json, with the slot it was given); later runs only check that the pinned tag turns (a 45 deg check wiggle) and re-bind, said loudly, a robot with no pin or a failed check. pins: typed pins, e.g. {"AL-1DC0": {"tag": 2, "slot": "Alpha"}} (ids and names only), under what the Pi has found. unclaimed: refuse (a roof tag on the table that no robot of the run turned stops the run before it starts) or ignore.

_note_production: The default production mission Mission Control loads: Alpha zones 1-2, Bravo zones 3-4 (the cameras' split at x = 78 in), each in a short order (nearest neighbour then 2-opt) from its home and back, its home point first. To fix an order by hand: "orders": {"Alpha": ["P11", ...], "Bravo": [...]} (used instead of the zones).
_note_run_tracking: run_tracking: how the robots are followed during a run. tags = roof AprilTags (tag bridge); lights = the robots' lights and outlines (home's camera bridge; the table's frame from corner clicking, Setup screen); none = no camera at all: each robot starts on its home sticker by hand and drives on its wheels and gyro; the +- grows 0.07 cm per cm driven. Mission Control's Run screen has the same choice. Corner tags: ref_tags.use false switches them off (corner_clicks then needed for lights).
_guesses: GUESSES, not used by the robots: antennas about 35 in out from each table corner, aimed diagonally in (Jay-Sun 3 Nov; taken as 35 in along the diagonal = 24.7 in each way). Jay-Sun measures exact positions, heights and tilts 4 Nov.
_note_experiments: Jay-Sun 3 Nov (tools/fleet/experiments.py): experiment routes shakedown (no camera, default orders), e1 in order, e2 reversed, e3 zig-zag, e4 shuffled (seed recorded). Halves = production.zones; swap_halves auto = every other run (counter in the site's folder), on / off to choose. cross_points: points of the other half each robot takes in e2-e4 (legs over x = middle_in). speed: pinned in the planner for every experiment. sync_wiggle.use: both robots a quarter turn (deg) and back at their homes at the start, pause_s stops (on at school; home has no block = off).
_note_frames_part_s: frames_part_s: the tracking-rate pictures are cut into .avi parts this long (s); each part is held in memory until written (300 s parts: 1.2 GB, 3 GB while writing, in the simulator's longest experiment). 60 s at school (Claude's choice, 3 Nov); delete the line for the old 300 s.

_note_calibration: calib_run.py (4 Nov 2026): robot_ips = addresses asked first (besides the WiFi broadcast) when finding the robot for the calibration run; tonight Alvik 3 (WiFi name AL-1DC0). tags.binding: wiggle (bind the roof tag that follows each robot's wiggle) or fixed (tags.ids, the old way). 5 Nov: save_on_robot: the fitted values are kept on the robot over power-off (firmware 2026-11-05a `save`); old_firmware_save: corr (a robot on older firmware: `corr save` per value, its storage since 2026-10-20b) or off (not saved, said). Every robot found is calibrated in turn, at P11, P05, P01 (calib_run.PARK_SPOTS). 5 Nov 11:00 (Nick): min_firmware: every run (calibration and the missions' wiggle) refuses a robot on older firmware, said plainly ("" = no check). old_firmware_save off: the corr save fallback is kept in the code, switched off (set corr to use it). baseline: auto (a robot's FIRST calibration on this site starts phase A from 1 / 1 / 0; later ones from its saved values; record calibrated_robots.json on the Pi), defaults or saved (the run's --baseline-defaults / --from-saved win). park_spots: where each robot is calibrated and parked, in order (P11, P01, P09; P05 before 11:00).
